faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Field Assistant/Lab Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 5 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Chamber of Officer Incharge, Agricultural Research Station, Badnapur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years. Relaxation: SC/ST/NT/OBC Age relaxation as per rule.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 22,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Appointment will be on contract basis. No TA/DA will be provided for appearing the interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny and Verification of original documents. Interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on temporary basis upto 31.03.2027 or earlier as per availability of the budget. No claim for regular appointment under VNMKV, Parbhani.
